surrealdb_authority_v02_205.supersedes: The pre-pivot PostgreSQL base-image registry/DDL/proof design in MT-321/322.
surrealdb_authority_v02_205.implementation_rule: Base-image registry and build receipts use MT-331..334 SurrealDB boundaries and record-user privacy; no PostgreSQL fallback or proof.
surrealdb_authority_v02_205.postgresql_data_migration: NOT_REQUIRED: no valuable live information exists in PostgreSQL; no connection, import, fallback or proof path is allowed.

title: DW-MT330-DeterministicBaseImageBuilder
group: DW Durable workspace volumes and handoff
clause: Build reproducible, content-addressed, read-only microVM base images and register them in SurrealDB.

scope.summary: Create a Rust-owned base-image builder from pinned, content-addressed inputs and a declared toolchain manifest. Normalize timestamps/order/ownership, build raw or qcow2 output under the external runtime root, hash and verify the final image, commit it to MT-321 CAS as read-only, and atomically register toolchain, digest, size, format, dependency/SBOM and build receipt records in SurrealDB. A failed or nondeterministic build never becomes selectable.
acceptance_criteria: Two clean builds from the same manifest produce the same digest or a typed nondeterminism failure with a file-level difference report.
Every dependency is pinned and recorded; offline rebuild succeeds from the managed content-addressed acquisition cache.
Image is verified, read-only and registered in SurrealDB only after full success; partial outputs remain unreachable and are safely swept.
MT-322 can resolve the registered toolchain and create a delta without ever opening the base for write.
proof_targets: Two independent deterministic builds and digest comparison.
Authenticated SurrealDB registry reread and cross-account denial.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend builder; MT-327/345 own operator surfaces.

risk_if_missed: Mutable or nondeterministic base images invalidate child overlays, prevent reproducible agent workspaces and corrupt provenance.

minimum_controls: content-addressed pinned inputs and double-build proof

surrealdb_translation_v02_205.schema_rule: Any embedded PostgreSQL DDL/SQL snippet is a semantic field/index/invariant inventory only. Implement it as SCHEMAFULL SurrealQL through SurrealKit; do not execute or mechanically transliterate the snippet.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.concurrency_rule: Translate advisory locks, SKIP LOCKED and row locks into SurrealDB transactions, durable lease/fencing records and conditional updates with equivalent tests.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.notification_rule: Translate LISTEN/NOTIFY into scoped SurrealDB live queries plus bounded resynchronization.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.privacy_rule: Translate RLS into authenticated record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker; administrative credentials cannot prove privacy.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.proof_rule: All named storage proofs run against real SurrealDB. No PostgreSQL process, driver, connection, fixture, environment variable or fallback is permitted.
